caption: The drawing depicts a lidded, urn-shaped vessel rendered in detailed grayscale pencil or ink on an off-white background. The object features a rounded body that narrows toward a slender stem and stands on a square base. The lid is dome-shaped, topped by an ornate finial resembling a small pinecone or fruit, with two small handles or projections on either side of the finial’s base. The top rim of the vessel and base are decorated with a beaded edge. The main body displays an elaborate decorative design on its surface, including a central monogram with the letters "CG" surrounded by a symmetrical frame of stylized foliage, scrollwork, and ornamental motifs. The name "Hans Wf Stendorf" is inscribed in small, uppercase letters at the lower left of the composition. The entire drawing is composed with careful shading and fine line work, providing a metallic and reflective appearance to the vessel.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
